chapter.name: Dhyana Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna teaches Arjuna about meditation and the practice of yoga discipline.  This chapter focuses on the techniques and benefits of meditation, the nature of the mind, the importance of self-discipline, the obstacles to meditation, and how to overcome them.  It is considered one of the most practical chapters for meditation practitioners.
chapter.theme: The practice of meditation, mind control, self-discipline, and the attainment of inner peace and self-realization through systematic yoga
chapter.yogaType: Dhyana Yoga - Yoga of Meditation and Concentration

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः | स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | anāśritaḥ karma-phalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ | sa sannyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnir na cākriyaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: One who performs their duty without attachment to the results is a true renunciate and yogi, not one who merely gives up action.
verses.meaning: True renunciation lies in selfless action, not in abandoning work.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव | न ह्यसंन्यस्तसंकल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ||
verses.transliteration: yaṃ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava | na hy asannyasta-saṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana ||
verses.english_translation: What is called renunciation is the same as yoga. One cannot become a yogi without giving up desires.
verses.meaning: Letting go of desires is essential for spiritual discipline.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते | योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: ārurukṣor muner yogaṃ karma kāraṇam ucyate | yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇam ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: For one seeking to attain yoga, action is the means; for one established in yoga, tranquility is the means.
verses.meaning: Action leads to discipline; once achieved, inner peace becomes the focus.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते | सर्वसंकल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasv anuṣajjate | sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadocyate ||
verses.english_translation: When one is no longer attached to sense objects or actions, they are said to be established in yoga.
verses.meaning: Detachment marks spiritual maturity.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् | आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ||
verses.transliteration: uddhared ātmanātmānaṃ nātmānam avasādayet | ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One should uplift oneself by one's own mind, not degrade oneself. The mind can be a friend or an enemy.
verses.meaning: Self-discipline determines whether the mind helps or harms us.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः | अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ||
verses.transliteration: bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ | anātmanas tu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat ||
verses.english_translation: For one who has conquered the mind, it is a friend; for one who has not, it remains an enemy.
verses.meaning: Control over mind leads to inner support; lack of control leads to conflict.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः | शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ||
verses.transliteration: jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ | śītoṣṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who has conquered the mind remains peaceful in heat and cold, pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor.
verses.meaning: A disciplined mind brings stability in all situations.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः | युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ||
verses.transliteration: jñāna-vijñāna-tṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ | yukta ity ucyate yogī sama-loṣṭāśma-kāñcanaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: A yogi who is satisfied with knowledge and realization sees a clod, stone, and gold as the same.
verses.meaning: True wisdom removes distinctions and attachments.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु | साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ||
verses.transliteration: suhṛn-mitrāry-udāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣya-bandhuṣu | sādhuṣv api ca pāpeṣu sama-buddhir viśiṣyate ||
verses.english_translation: One who has equal regard for friend, enemy, neutral, and all others is considered superior.
verses.meaning: Equanimity toward all beings is a mark of spiritual progress.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः | एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः ||
verses.transliteration: yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ | ekākī yata-cittātmā nirāśīr aparigrahaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: A yogi should constantly practice meditation in solitude, controlling mind and body, free from desires and possessions.
verses.meaning: Regular disciplined meditation in simplicity leads to spiritual growth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः | नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ||
verses.transliteration: śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ | nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājina-kuśottaram ||
verses.english_translation: In a clean place, establish a firm seat, neither too high nor too low, covered with cloth, deer skin, and kusa grass.
verses.meaning: Krishna describes the proper setup for meditation—clean, stable, and balanced.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः | उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये ||
verses.transliteration: tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yata-cittendriya-kriyaḥ | upaviśyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśuddhaye ||
verses.english_translation: Sitting there, focusing the mind and controlling thoughts and senses, one should practice yoga for self-purification.
verses.meaning: Meditation requires concentration and control of mind and senses.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः | संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ||
verses.transliteration: samaṃ kāya-śiro-grīvaṃ dhārayann acalaṃ sthiraḥ | saṃprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaś cānavalokayan ||
verses.english_translation: Keeping the body, head, and neck straight and steady, and gazing at the tip of the nose without looking around.
verses.meaning: Proper posture and focus are essential for meditation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः | मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ||
verses.transliteration: praśāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmacāri-vrate sthitaḥ | manaḥ saṃyamya mac-citto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ ||
verses.english_translation: With a peaceful mind, free from fear, practicing celibacy, controlling the mind, and focusing on Me, one should sit in meditation.
verses.meaning: Meditation requires calmness, discipline, and focus on the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः | शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: yuñjann evaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ | śāntiṃ nirvāṇa-paramāṃ mat-saṃsthām adhigacchati ||
verses.english_translation: Thus practicing constantly, the yogi with controlled mind attains peace and ultimate liberation in Me.
verses.meaning: Consistent meditation leads to supreme peace and union with the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः | न चाति स्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ||
verses.transliteration: nātyaśnatas tu yogo 'sti na caikāntam anaśnataḥ | na cāti-svapna-śīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ||
verses.english_translation: Yoga is not for one who eats too much or too little, nor for one who sleeps too much or too little.
verses.meaning: Moderation in lifestyle is essential for successful meditation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु | युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ||
verses.transliteration: yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-ceṣṭasya karmasu | yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā ||
verses.english_translation: For one who is balanced in eating, recreation, work, and sleep, yoga becomes a destroyer of sorrow.
verses.meaning: Balanced living supports spiritual growth and removes suffering.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते | निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा ||
verses.transliteration: yadā viniyataṃ cittam ātmany evāvatiṣṭhate | niḥspṛhaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ity ucyate tadā ||
verses.english_translation: When the controlled mind rests in the self alone, free from desires, one is said to be established in yoga.
verses.meaning: Freedom from desires and inner focus define true yoga.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता | योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ||
verses.transliteration: yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā | yogino yata-cittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Like a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so is the disciplined mind of a yogi in meditation.
verses.meaning: A steady mind is the ideal state in meditation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया | यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति ||
verses.transliteration: yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yoga-sevayā | yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyann ātmani tuṣyati ||
verses.english_translation: When the mind is restrained through meditation and one sees the self within and is satisfied in the self.
verses.meaning: Meditation leads to self-realization and inner satisfaction.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् | वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ||
verses.transliteration: sukham ātyantikaṃ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam | vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaś calati tattvataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The yogi experiences supreme happiness, grasped by the intellect and beyond the senses; once established, one never departs from it.
verses.meaning: True spiritual bliss is beyond senses and once realized, it remains stable.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः | यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ | yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate ||
verses.english_translation: Having attained this, one considers no other gain greater; being established in it, one is not shaken even by great sorrow.
verses.meaning: Spiritual realization brings unshakable stability and fulfillment.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तं विद्याद्दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् | स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ||
verses.transliteration: taṃ vidyād duḥkha-saṃyoga-viyogaṃ yoga-saṃjñitam | sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo 'nirviṇṇa-cetasā ||
verses.english_translation: Know that yoga is the disconnection from union with sorrow; it should be practiced with determination and without discouragement.
verses.meaning: Yoga is freedom from suffering and requires steady effort.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः | मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ||
verses.transliteration: saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāṃs tyaktvā sarvān aśeṣataḥ | manasaivendriya-grāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Abandoning all desires born of thoughts and controlling the senses from all sides by the mind.
verses.meaning: Control over thoughts and senses is essential for meditation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया | आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ||
verses.transliteration: śanaiḥ śanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛti-gṛhītayā | ātma-saṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcid api cintayet ||
verses.english_translation: Gradually, step by step, with firm intellect, one should bring the mind under control and focus it on the self.
verses.meaning: Meditation requires patience and gradual control of the mind.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् | ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ||
verses.transliteration: yato yato niścarati manaś cañcalam asthiram | tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmany eva vaśaṃ nayet ||
verses.english_translation: Wherever the restless mind wanders, one should bring it back under control and direct it toward the self.
verses.meaning: Repeated practice is needed to control the wandering mind.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् | उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम् ||
verses.transliteration: praśānta-manasaṃ hy enaṃ yoginaṃ sukham uttamam | upaiti śānta-rajasam brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣam ||
verses.english_translation: Supreme happiness comes to the yogi whose mind is peaceful, whose passions are calmed, and who is free from sin.
verses.meaning: A calm and pure mind leads to true happiness.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः | सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते ||
verses.transliteration: yuñjann evaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigata-kalmaṣaḥ | sukhena brahma-saṃsparśam atyantaṃ sukham aśnute ||
verses.english_translation: Thus practicing constantly, the yogi, free from impurities, attains supreme happiness through union with Brahman.
verses.meaning: Continuous practice leads to ultimate spiritual bliss.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि | ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṃ sarva-bhūtāni cātmani | īkṣate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśanaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: A yogi sees the self in all beings and all beings in the self, maintaining equal vision everywhere.
verses.meaning: True realization brings unity and equality in perception.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति | तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati | tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
verses.english_translation: One who sees Me everywhere and everything in Me is never separated from Me, nor am I ever separated from them.
verses.meaning: Seeing the divine in everything leads to eternal connection with God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः | सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-bhūta-sthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajaty ekatvam āsthitaḥ | sarvathā vartamāno 'pi sa yogī mayi vartate ||
verses.english_translation: The yogi who worships Me as present in all beings lives in Me, regardless of his mode of life.
verses.meaning: Seeing the divine in all beings connects one constantly with God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन | सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ||
verses.transliteration: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo 'rjuna | sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who sees the happiness and suffering of all beings as his own is considered the highest yogi.
verses.meaning: Empathy and equality define the highest spiritual state.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन | एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | yo 'yaṃ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana | etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṃ sthirām ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: This yoga of equanimity you describe seems impractical to me because the mind is restless.
verses.meaning: Arjuna expresses doubt about controlling the restless mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम् | तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् ||
verses.transliteration: cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham | tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyor iva su-duṣkaram ||
verses.english_translation: The mind is restless, turbulent, strong, and stubborn; controlling it seems as difficult as controlling the wind.
verses.meaning: Arjuna highlights the difficulty of mastering the mind.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् | अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | asaṃśayaṃ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam | abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: The mind is indeed difficult to control, but it can be controlled through practice and detachment.
verses.meaning: Consistent practice and detachment are the keys to controlling the mind.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः | वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः ||
verses.transliteration: asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ | vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo 'vāptum upāyataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Yoga is difficult for one who lacks self-control, but it is attainable for one who strives with discipline.
verses.meaning: Self-discipline is essential for achieving yoga.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः | अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāc calita-mānasaḥ | aprāpya yoga-saṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: What happens to one who starts with faith but fails to attain perfection in yoga due to a restless mind?
verses.meaning: Arjuna asks about the fate of an unsuccessful yogi.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति | अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ||
verses.transliteration: kaccin nobhaya-vibhraṣṭaś chinnābhram iva naśyati | apratiṣṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi ||
verses.english_translation: Does such a person perish like a scattered cloud, lost from both paths and without support?
verses.meaning: Arjuna fears failure in both worldly and spiritual pursuits.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः | त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते ||
verses.transliteration: etan me saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettum arhasy aśeṣataḥ | tvad anyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hy upapadyate ||
verses.english_translation: Please dispel this doubt completely, O Krishna, for none other than you can do so.
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks clarity from Krishna about spiritual uncertainty.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते | न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśas tasya vidyate | na hi kalyāṇa-kṛt kaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: One who does good never comes to harm, neither in this world nor the next.
verses.meaning: Krishna reassures that sincere spiritual effort is never wasted.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः | शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ||
verses.transliteration: prāpya puṇya-kṛtāṃ lokān uṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yoga-bhraṣṭo 'bhijāyate ||
verses.english_translation: The unsuccessful yogi, after enjoying heavenly worlds, is born in a pure and prosperous family.
verses.meaning: Spiritual effort never goes to waste; it continues in future lives.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् | एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ||
verses.transliteration: athavā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām | etad dhi durlabhataram loke janma yad īdṛśam ||
verses.english_translation: Or one is born into a family of wise yogis, which is even rarer.
verses.meaning: A higher birth provides better conditions for spiritual progress.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् | यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ||
verses.transliteration: tatra taṃ buddhi-saṃyogaṃ labhate paurva-dehikam | yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kuru-nandana ||
verses.english_translation: There, one regains the knowledge from the previous life and strives again for perfection.
verses.meaning: Past spiritual efforts help continue the journey.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः | जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ||
verses.transliteration: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hy avaśo 'pi saḥ | jijñāsur api yogasya śabda-brahmātivartate ||
verses.english_translation: By previous practice, one is naturally drawn to yoga, even without conscious effort.
verses.meaning: Spiritual habits carry forward across lifetimes.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः | अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī saṃśuddha-kilbiṣaḥ | aneka-janma-saṃsiddhas tato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: With effort, the yogi becomes purified of sins and, after many births, attains the highest goal.
verses.meaning: Persistent effort leads to ultimate liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः | कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ||
verses.transliteration: tapasvibhyo 'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo 'pi mato 'dhikaḥ | karmibhyaś cādhiko yogī tasmād yogī bhavārjuna ||
verses.english_translation: The yogi is superior to ascetics, scholars, and those who perform rituals; therefore, become a yogi.
verses.meaning: Krishna emphasizes the importance of the path of yoga.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना | श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ||
verses.transliteration: yoginām api sarveṣāṃ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā | śraddhāvān bhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Among all yogis, the one who worships Me with faith and devotion is the highest.
verses.meaning: Devotion combined with yoga is considered the सर्वोत्तम (highest) path.
